LESSON: SQUARES AND SQUARE ROOTS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers 1.4 Decimals (6 lessons) • Place value and total value • Multiplicati on
Topic 1.5: Squares and Square Roots
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Squares and Square Roots, part of Numbers 1.4 Decimals (6 lessons) • Place value and total value • Multiplicati on in Grade 7 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: Where do we apply squares and square roots in daily activities? 2. How do we apply squares and square roots in daily activities?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. determine the squares of whole numbers, fractions, and decimals by multiplication in different situations

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Squares and Square Roots in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. determine the square roots of whole numbers, fractions, and decimals of perfect squares in different situations

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Squares and Square Roots in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the use of squares and square roots in real-life situations.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Squares and Square Roots in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. determine the squares of whole numbers, fractions, and decimals by multiplication in different situations

   Squares and Square Roots helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. determine the square roots of whole numbers, fractions, and decimals of perfect squares in different situations

   Squares and Square Roots helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. appreciate the use of squares and square roots in real-life situations.

   Squares and Square Roots helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work out squares of numbers using: o grids and charts o long multiplication method o using calculators

2. work out square roots of numbers using: o factors method o division method o calculators

3. use IT devices to play games involving squares and square roots. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work out squares of numbers using: o grids and charts o long multiplication method o using calculators
2. work out square roots of numbers using: o factors method o division method o calculators
3. use IT devices to play games involving squares and square roots. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Squares and Square Roots together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and Problem-solving: reflection as the learner uses grid squares and charts to find squares and square roots

of numbers.

● Digital Literacy: interacting with technologies as the learner uses IT devices to work out squares and square roots of

numbers.

Values

● Respect: as the learner appreciates each other’s contribution in using grids and charts

● Unity: as the learner shares and works out the factors of numbers to get the square roots of numbers.
